comment: The step catalogue: the contract every interop agent and client program implements. README.md (Contracts) explains the conventions; GenConfigs.java reads this file. Step ids are stable: never rename one, add a new id instead. Order matters: the generator runs steps in this order.

placeholders.{dir}: An absolute scratch directory the client creates once per run (no spaces). Agent and client run on the same host, so both can read and write it.

permission.clientRule: Answer `cancelled` if this session has a cancel in flight (perm.cancelled); otherwise select the first option whose kind is allow_once, else options[0].

directives.agent: Send two agent_message_chunk updates, "echo: " then the prompt text, and answer end_turn. Record the turn in the session's history (for session.load-replay).

session/request_permission with fixtures.permission. Then send the chunk "permission: selected <optionId>" (or "permission: cancelled") and answer end_turn. Print STEP agent.perm.selected PASS iff the outcome is selected/allow.
As allow, but the client cancels the turn while the request is pending. Print STEP agent.perm.cancelled PASS iff the outcome is cancelled, and answer stopReason cancelled.
Require client.fs.writeTextFile. fs/write_text_file {path, content}; accept {} or a null result. Send the chunk "fs write ok" (or "fs write error <code>") and answer end_turn.
Require client.fs.readTextFile. fs/read_text_file; send the returned content as one chunk (or "fs read error <code>") and answer end_turn.
fs/read_text_file, then after 200 ms send $/cancel_request for that request. Chunk "cancel-request sent"; answer end_turn.

Send one session/update of <kind> from fixtures.emit (tool_call_update is preceded by its tool_call; unknown is followed by the chunk "after-unknown"; name= sets the tool call name), then answer end_turn.
Send the chunk "stop" and answer with stopReason <reason>.
Send the chunk "tick" every 100 ms. On session/cancel keep ticking for grace ms (default 0), then answer cancelled. Without a cancel, answer end_turn after 10 s.
Never answer and ignore session/cancel (the SDK's own cancel grace must answer).
Require client.terminal. terminal/create, terminal/wait_for_exit, terminal/output, terminal/release. Chunk "terminal: <output trimmed> exit=<code>".
terminal/create, wait 200 ms, terminal/kill, terminal/wait_for_exit, terminal/release. Chunk "terminal killed".
elicitation/create with fixtures.elicitation.form. Chunk "elicit: <action> <content as JSON>".
elicitation/create (url mode, fixtures.elicitation.url), then elicitation/complete {elicitationId}. Chunk "elicit url done".
Send the extension request <method> with fixtures.ext.params to the client; chunk "ext: <result as JSON>".
Send the extension notification <method> with fixtures.ext.params; chunk "ext notified".
Chunk "ext last: <method of the last extension notification received, or none>".
Copy the prompt request's _meta into the _meta of one agent_message_chunk "meta" and of the PromptResponse.
Send the clientCapabilities received at initialize, as compact JSON, in one chunk.
Chunk "len=<payload length in characters>" (the payload is ASCII: everything after "#len ").
Send one agent_message_chunk of <bytes> ASCII 'x' characters.
Answer the prompt with a JSON-RPC error, code -32602, message "unknown directive: #<name>".

steps.client: Connect, then initialize with fixtures.client (advertise only capabilities the program really implements). This step is always first; the result is kept for the other init.* steps.

pass.client: The response arrives within the step timeout and protocolVersion == 1.

steps.client: Check the stored initialize response.

pass.client: agentCapabilities has loadSession true and sessionCapabilities list, resume, close and delete present (fixtures.agent).

steps.client: session/new, then the prompt.

pass.client: The chunk parses as JSON and has fs.readTextFile and fs.writeTextFile true and terminal true.
pass.agent: STEP agent.init.client-capabilities PASS when the initialize request carried clientCapabilities (any value) and the agent could serialize them.

steps.client: Check the stored initialize response.

pass.client: authMethods contains an entry with id interop-auth.

steps.client: Check the stored initialize response.

pass.client: agentInfo.name starts with "interop-".

steps.client: session/new, then the prompt.

pass.client: The echoed capabilities contain session.configOptions.boolean.

steps.client: authenticate {methodId: interop-auth}.

pass.client: A non-error response.
pass.agent: STEP agent.auth.authenticate PASS when methodId == interop-auth.

steps.client: logout {}.

pass.client: A non-error response.

steps.client: Check the stored initialize response.

pass.client: agentCapabilities.auth.logout is present.

steps.client: Check the stored initialize response.
steps.agent: List fixtures.agent.terminalAuthMethod in authMethods iff the client advertised auth.terminal.

pass.client: authMethods contains an entry with type terminal and id interop-terminal-auth.

steps.client: session/new {cwd: {dir}, mcpServers: []}.

pass.client: A non-empty sessionId.

steps.client: session/new; prompt "hello load"; session/load {sessionId, cwd: {dir}, mcpServers: []}; prompt "after load".
steps.agent: Accept the load of a session it created.

pass.client: The load answers without error, and the prompt after it answers end_turn with at least one agent_message_chunk for the session.

steps.client: session/new; prompt "replay me"; session/load. Count updates for the session from the load request until replayGraceMs after its response (replay may arrive on either side of the response: RFD gaps A/C).
steps.agent: Before answering session/load, replay the history: per earlier turn one user_message_chunk with the prompt text, then the agent_message_chunk updates it sent.

pass.client: A user_message_chunk "replay me" and an agent_message_chunk containing "replay me" arrived.

steps.client: session/new; prompt "before resume"; session/resume {sessionId, cwd: {dir}}; prompt "after resume".

pass.client: The resume answers without error, no update for the session arrives between the resume request and updateGraceMs after its response, and the next prompt answers end_turn.

steps.client: session/new {cwd: {dir}/list}; session/list {cwd: {dir}/list}, following nextCursor (at most 10 pages).
steps.agent: List the sessions it created, filtered by cwd; any page size.

pass.client: The new sessionId is listed, with cwd {dir}/list.

steps.client: session/new; start prompt "#slow"; after the first tick, session/close {sessionId}; then prompt "after close" on the closed session.
steps.agent: Cancel the session's running work and answer {}. Reject later requests for the session.

pass.client: close answers {}, the #slow prompt ends (cancelled or an error) within 5 s of the close, and the prompt after close fails with an error.
pass.agent: STEP agent.session.close PASS when the close named a known session and its running turn was cancelled.

steps.client: session/new; session/delete {sessionId}; session/delete {sessionId: "no-such-session"}.

pass.client: Both deletes answer without error (deleting an unknown id succeeds silently).

steps.client: Two session/new on the main connection; send prompt "multi A" to the first and "multi B" to the second concurrently.

pass.client: Both answer end_turn; the first session's chunks spell "echo: multi A" and the second's "echo: multi B", with no update routed to the wrong session.

steps.client: session/new; prompt "before fork"; session/fork {sessionId, cwd: {dir}}; prompt "in fork" on the new id.

pass.client: The fork returns a sessionId different from the original, and the prompt on it answers end_turn.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: stopReason end_turn, and the agent_message_chunk texts for the session concatenate to "echo: hello" (updates may trail the response by updateGraceMs).

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: A user_message_chunk with text "user-chunk", and end_turn.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: An agent_thought_chunk with text "thinking", and end_turn.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: A tool_call with toolCallId call-1, title "interop tool", kind read, status pending.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: tool_call call-1, then tool_call_update call-1 with status completed and text content "tool output".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: The received tool_call has name "read_file".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: A plan with the two fixture entries, in order, with their priority and status.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: An available_commands_update with one command named "interop" whose input hint is "args".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: A current_mode_update with currentModeId interop-mode-b.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: A config_option_update whose model option has currentValue model-b.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: A session_info_update with title "interop title".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: A usage_update with used 100, size 1000 and cost 0.01 USD.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.
steps.agent: Send the unknown variant through an untyped/raw notification send if the typed API refuses it.

pass.client: The chunk "after-unknown" arrives and the prompt answers end_turn: the unknown update was dropped or surfaced, never fatal.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: stopReason max_tokens.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: stopReason refusal.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: stopReason max_turn_requests.

steps.client: session/new (the response carries fixtures.modes); session/set_mode {modeId: interop-mode-b}.
steps.agent: Return fixtures.modes on session/new; accept set_mode for a known mode.

pass.client: session/new returned availableModes with interop-mode-b, and set_mode answers without error.
pass.agent: STEP agent.mode.set PASS when set_mode named a known session and interop-mode-b.

steps.client: session/new.
steps.agent: Return fixtures.configOptions (verbose only if the client advertised configOptions.boolean) on session/new, session/load and session/resume.

pass.client: The response has a select option model with currentValue model-a.

steps.client: session/new; session/set_config_option {configId: model, value: model-b}.

pass.client: The response is the complete list of options, with model at currentValue model-b.

steps.client: session/new; session/set_config_option {configId: verbose, type: boolean, value: true}.

pass.client: The response has verbose at currentValue true.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; answer the permission request per fixtures.permission.clientRule.

pass.client: Exactly one session/request_permission arrived during the turn, with at least one option; the chunk "permission: selected allow" arrived; end_turn.
pass.agent: STEP agent.perm.selected PASS when the outcome is selected with optionId allow.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; when the permission request arrives, send session/cancel, then answer the request with outcome cancelled.

pass.client: stopReason cancelled within 5 s of the cancel.
pass.agent: STEP agent.perm.cancelled PASS when the outcome is cancelled.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt. The fs/write_text_file handler writes the file. A client whose SDK answers "result": null (Python) is the null-result case, which the agent must accept.

pass.client: end_turn, the chunk "fs write ok" arrived, and {dir}/fs-write.txt contains exactly "interop write".
pass.agent: STEP agent.fs.write PASS when fs/write_text_file answered without error ({} or null).

steps.client: Write fixtures.fsReadContent to {dir}/fs-read.txt; session/new; the prompt. The fs/read_text_file handler reads the file.

pass.client: A chunk equal to fixtures.fsReadContent.
pass.agent: STEP agent.fs.read PASS when the content equals fixtures.fsReadContent.

steps.client: As fs.read; the handler honours line (1-based) and limit.

pass.client: A chunk that, trimmed, equals "line2".
pass.agent: STEP agent.fs.read-range PASS when the content, trimmed, equals "line2".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt. The handler answers a JSON-RPC error for a missing file.

pass.client: A chunk starting "fs read error" and end_turn: the agent got an error, not a hang.
pass.agent: STEP agent.fs.read-missing PASS when fs/read_text_file failed with a JSON-RPC error.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt. The terminal handlers run real processes.

pass.client: The chunk "terminal: hi exit=0".
pass.agent: STEP agent.term.run PASS when the output contains "hi" and exitCode is 0.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: The chunk "terminal killed" within 5 s.
pass.agent: STEP agent.term.kill PASS when wait_for_exit returned within 5 s of the kill.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; answer elicitation/create with fixtures.elicitation.formAnswer.

pass.client: The chunk "elicit: accept {\"name\":\"interop\"}" (JSON compared semantically).
pass.agent: STEP agent.elicit.form PASS when the action is accept with content name == interop.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; accept the url-mode elicitation.

pass.client: An elicitation/complete notification for elic-1 arrived before the response (plus updateGraceMs).

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; after the first "tick", session/cancel.

pass.client: stopReason cancelled within 5 s of the cancel (ticks after the cancel and before the response are allowed).
pass.agent: STEP agent.cancel.prompt PASS when session/cancel arrived for the running session.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; after the first tick, session/cancel, then at once prompt "during cancel" on the same session; after the first prompt answers, prompt "after cancel".

pass.client: The first prompt answers cancelled, "during cancel" fails with -32600 (invalid request), and "after cancel" answers end_turn. Java SDK policy (G0e), so only asserted against Java agents.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; after 200 ms, session/cancel.
steps.agent: #hang. The Java agent program configures its cancel grace to 1 s.

pass.client: stopReason cancelled within 6 s of the cancel: the SDK answered for the handler (G0f).

steps.client: session/new; the prompt; after the first tick, $/cancel_request {requestId: <the prompt's id>}.
steps.agent: #slow; the SDK surfaces the cancel request to the handler.

pass.client: The prompt ends within 5 s, with error -32800 or stopReason cancelled.
pass.agent: STEP agent.cancel-request.client PASS when the handler observed the cancel request.

steps.client: session/new; the prompt. The fs/read_text_file handler, for a path ending slow.txt, waits up to 10 s or until cancelled.

pass.client: The chunk "cancel-request sent" and end_turn within 5 s.
pass.agent: STEP agent.cancel-request.agent PASS when the fs request ended with error -32800 within 5 s.

steps.client: $/cancel_request for requestId 999999, and for the id of a request that already completed; then session/new and prompt "after cancel-request".

pass.client: No error comes back for either cancel request, and the prompt answers end_turn.

steps.client: Register a handler for _interop/ping that answers fixtures.ext.result; session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: The chunk "ext: {\"pong\":1}".
pass.agent: STEP agent.ext.agent-request PASS when the result is {pong: 1}.

steps.client: Register a handler for _interop/note; session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: The notification arrived with params {n: 1}.

steps.client: Send the request _interop/ping {n: 1} to the agent.

pass.client: The result is {pong: 1}.

steps.client: Send the notification _interop/note {n: 1}; session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: The chunk "ext last: _interop/note".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt with _meta {"interop": "m1"} on the PromptRequest.

pass.client: The "meta" chunk's update _meta and the PromptResponse _meta both have interop == m1.

steps.client: As perm.selected, and put the request's _meta into the RequestPermissionResponse's _meta.

pass.client: The request carried _meta interop == m1.
pass.agent: STEP agent.meta.permission PASS when the response carried _meta interop == m1.

steps.client: Send a request for a method no interop agent implements: providers/list (an unstable method) through the typed API, or interop/no_such_method through a generic send. Then session/new.

pass.client: The request fails with -32601 and the session/new after it succeeds (the connection survived).

steps.client: session/new; prompt "#len " followed by 1048576 'x'.

pass.client: The chunk "len=1048576".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: One agent_message_chunk of exactly 1048576 characters.

steps.client: session/new; prompt "#len " followed by 8388608 'x'.

pass.client: The chunk "len=8388608".

steps.client: session/new; the prompt.

pass.client: One agent_message_chunk of exactly 8388608 characters.

steps.client: On a second connection: initialize, session/new, prompt "before reconnect", close it. On a third: initialize, session/load of that session, prompt "after reconnect", close it.

pass.client: Every request answers without error and both prompts answer end_turn.

steps.client: Spawn a second agent from AGENT_CMD, initialize it, close its stdin and wait.
steps.agent: Exit (any code) when stdin reaches EOF.

pass.client: The child exits within 5 s of the EOF (otherwise kill it and FAIL with "no exit on EOF").

steps.client: Close the main connection through the SDK's graceful close (HTTP: DELETE; WS: close frame; stdio: end the child). Always last.

pass.client: The close completes within the step timeout without an error.
